actions.label: Health check

actions.label: Start delegated connection
actions.description: Ask to connect this agent to your Spoonjoy account.
actions.agent: Start a browser-approved delegated Spoonjoy connection for this agent. Show the user authorizationUrl and, separately, userCode: they open the link, sign in and type the code to approve. Then poll with deviceCode. Grants kitchen and shopping-list scopes only, never account access.

actions.label: Poll delegated connection
actions.description: Check whether you approved this agent's connection.

tokenName.label: Token name

actions.label: Search Spoonjoy
actions.description: Search recipes, cookbooks, chefs and your shopping list.
actions.agent: Full-text search Spoonjoy recipes, cookbooks, chefs, and the configured owner's private shopping list. Without commas every query word must match; commas separate alternatives, so a result matching any of them is returned, ordered by how many alternatives it matches, and at most 12 alternatives are used.

query.label: Search
query.description: The words to search for. Every word must match; commas separate alternatives, any of which may match.

scope.label: Where
scope.description: What to search: all, or one kind of result.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 25.

actions.label: Update recipe
actions.description: Change one of your recipes.
actions.agent: Update a recipe owned by the configured owner. With steps, the recipe's steps become the given list, in order: a step with an id updates that step, a step without one updates the step at its position or is added, and steps left out are removed. Updated steps keep their ids, their ingredients keep theirs, and a step keeps the steps whose output it uses unless outputStepNums says otherwise. Each ingredient appears in one step only.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

imageUrl.label: Photo
imageUrl.description: A Spoonjoy image URL from upload_recipe_image, or null to clear it.

steps.label: Steps

description.description: What to do in this step.

duration.description: How long the step takes, in minutes.

unit.label: Unit
unit.description: The unit for the quantity, such as grams or cups.

outputStepNums.label: Uses output of
outputStepNums.description: Earlier step numbers, in this list's order, whose output this step uses.

actions.label: Fork recipe
actions.description: Make your own copy of a recipe.
actions.agent: Fork an existing Spoonjoy recipe into the authenticated principal's kitchen. Clones title, description, servings, steps, ingredients, and step-output uses; snapshots the source's latest cover; sets sourceRecipeId on the new recipe. Retrying the same fork (the same idempotencyKey, or the same source and title without a key) within 24 hours returns the first fork instead of creating another, unless that fork was deleted.

sourceRecipeId.label: Recipe
sourceRecipeId.description: The recipe to fork, by id.

title.label: Title
title.description: Optional title override. Subject to the same `(chefId, title)` collision suffixing as the default title.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency key
idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for a replay-safe fork; reuse it when retrying.

quantity.label: Quantity

unit.description: The unit for the quantity, such as grams, cups or cans. Leave it out for a plain count.

categoryKey.label: Category

iconKey.label: Icon

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key again when retrying this exact call, such as after a timeout, and the item is added once.
